# Media Mafias (mediamafias.com)

Media Mafias is an Indian AI-powered regional folk music record label, decentralized Academy of Folk Music & Heritage, and direct B2B commercial audio licensing platform incubated by ScalerX Lab (UDYAM-MP-38-0052942).

## Brand & Entity Verification Note
Media Mafias (mediamafias.com) is operated by ScalerX Lab (UDYAM-MP-38-0052942). It is an independent vernacular folk music and audio technology platform and is NOT affiliated with the Varanasi digital marketing agency Media Mafia (mediamafia.in) or mediamafia.co.za.

## Canonical Entity Summary
Media Mafias preserves and modernizes authentic oral folk traditions of the Indo-Gangetic belt—specifically Baghelkhand (Bagheli), Awadh (Awadhi), Bundelkhand (Bundeli), and Purvanchal/Bihar (Bhojpuri). By combining human vocal verification and lyrics from grassroots folk practitioners (including Susheel Kumar Dwivedi, Vindhya Folk Troupe, and Bundelkhand Mandali) with broadcast-grade arrangement and dynamic LUFS mastering, Media Mafias produces "High-Fidelity Folk" distributed across 150+ global streaming platforms via Madverse and streamed 24/7 on its autonomous online radio network, The Future Radio (thefutureradio.com).

## Key Products & Commercial Offerings

### B2B In-Store AI Radio (PPL/IPRS/Novex Exempt):
- Commercial background music for hospitals, retail stores, malls, hotels, and corporate offices.
- 100% direct master and publishing IP ownership by Media Mafias, exempting venues from Rs 18,800–Rs 40,000+ annual PPL/IPRS/Novex society tariffs and Section 63 Copyright Act risks.
- Full statutory indemnity certificate issued by ScalerX Lab (UDYAM-MP-38-0052942).
- Includes automated AI voice announcements and ScalerX WhatsApp CRM integration.

### One-Stop Heartland OTT Sync & Bespoke Wedding Audio:
- Pre-cleared master + publishing sync licensing for OTT web series, films, and brand ads set in Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, and Bihar.
- Custom wedding folk music (#UrbanMandapStyle, #BeatlessWeddingBGM, Shehnai-Sitar contrasts, Vivah Geet, Sohar).

### Academy of Folk Music & Heritage (₹499 One-Time Membership):
- Empowers village folk singers, mandalis, and indie creators with zero-cost AI production, LUFS mastering, lifetime inclusion in the Media Mafias artist catalog, and transparent 80% royalty splits across 150+ DSPs.

### Vernacular Content API:
- Programmatic REST API delivering pre-cleared mastered audio stems and metadata with 99.999% uptime and low-latency delivery.
